text:
The splendid paper palace of childhood pilgrimages.
+
+
+At sunset they will put the tightrope walker in a cage, carry her to a ruined temple, and leave her there alone.

translation.title: The Splendid Paper Palace of Childhood Pilgrimages…
translation.editorial_note: Volatinera becomes the female tightrope walker, preserving precarious performance before the abrupt ritual of caging, ruin, and abandonment.
